system_name: Journey to the West Narrative Cards · Karma, Artifact, Obsession
core_mechanism: Three card groups · any combination of three cards generates a brand-new story opening that still obeys the logic of the original novel
innovation: This is not a retelling of the story · but a story generator · 32 cards combine to produce 1200 story openings · turning Journey to the West from ”a classic” into ”an endless source”.

card_groups.description: Draw a scenario · e.g. 'Cast Out of the Monastery' or 'Mistaken Entry into a Demon Lair'

cards.context: Bodhi Patriarch expels Wukong from his school · forbidding him to mention his lineage · hinting at the hidden rules of the cultivation world

cards.scene: Mistaken Entry into a Demon Lair
cards.context: Straying into a demon king’s cave · your Monkey King true form exposed · drawn into a conspiracy
A past-life acquaintance appears with an unfamiliar face · an old karmic bond is rekindled
The master is carried off by a demon king · the disciple must rescue him in time
Rain falls after a long drought · the people are grateful · but the rain’s origin is suspect
Accidentally swallowing an immortal pill · its power surges through the body · triggering a mutation

cards.scene: Lost in the Wheel of Rebirth
cards.context: Plunging into the reincarnation passage · reborn under another identity · with temporary amnesia
A divine being enters a dream to point the way · waking half-convinced
A mortal with a sword challenges the pilgrim · claiming to carry out heaven’s will
Thunder tribulations strike from the ninth heaven · the sinner cannot escape · bystanders are caught too
The soul strays into the netherworld · meets the Ten Kings of Hell · and leafs through the Book of Life and Death

cards.scene: True and False Hard to Tell
cards.context: A counterfeit identical to the protagonist appears · no one can tell which is real

card_groups.description: Draw a resource · e.g. the 'Headband Curse' or the 'Lifesaving Hair'

cards.function: Worn on the head · the chant causes pain · the core tool for controlling the executor (Wukong)
Zhu Bajie’s weapon · weighs 5,048 jin · a farming tool turned weapon
The sea-pacifying divine needle · 13,500 jin · grows or shrinks at will
Taishang Laojun’s Palm-Leaf Fan · one wave quenches fire · two waves raise wind · three waves bring rain
Taishang Laojun’s treasure · snares all things without fail · bane of weapons
Forged in the Eight Trigrams Furnace · sees through demons’ true forms · but vulnerable to smoke
Sha Wujing’s weapon · from the Moon Palace · weighs 5,048 jin
Golden Horn King’s treasure · whoever answers their name is drawn in · turned to pus and blood
Yellow-Browed Demon’s treasure · all gods are drawn in · no escape for a time
Worn by Tang Sanzang · priceless · attracts demons and calamity

card_groups.description: Draw an inner obstacle · e.g. 'Pride', 'Suspicion' or 'Blind Loyalty'

cards.manifestation: Overestimates oneself · scorns the mortal world · refuses to bow
Paranoid and mistrustful · trusts no one · goes it alone
Blind obedience · never questions right or wrong · follows to the death
Covets treasures · lusts at beauty · never satisfied
A single cross word · rage ignites · reason lost
Clinging to reputation · caring about empty titles · forgetting one’s true nature
Craves immortality · clings to the flesh · rejects reincarnation
Obsessed with one person · heedless of all others · ruins a great cause
Sees others surpass oneself · breeds resentment · must destroy them
Avoids trouble · dares not take responsibility · shifts blame

example_combinations.combination: K02 Mistaken Entry into a Demon Lair + F03 Golden Cudgel + Z02 Suspicion
example_combinations.story_opening: In the dark demon lair Sun Wukong's Golden Cudgel suddenly refuses to obey: Tang Sanzang's suspicion of him has turned into an invisible force corroding the source of his magic.
example_combinations.story_continuation: Wukong's attack does the demon no harm at all - the demon uses it and reflects the Golden Cudgel's force back.
example_combinations.key_conflict: Suspicion weakens the trust between master and disciples and dims the Golden Cudgel's power.
example_combinations.thematic_resonance: Obsession is the greatest enemy; more frightening than demons is the suspicion in one's own heart.

example_combinations.combination: K03 An Old Acquaintance Reappears + F08 Purple-Gold Gourd + Z06 Reputation
example_combinations.story_opening: Far from home Wukong meets an old acquaintance who has been reborn as a demon and calls out his name with the Purple-Gold Gourd to take him in.
example_combinations.story_continuation: Fixated on the title 'Great Sage Equaling Heaven', Wukong answers to his name and is nearly swallowed by the gourd.
example_combinations.key_conflict: Reputation is Wukong's deepest obsession; the title 'Great Sage Equaling Heaven' cost him dearly back then.
example_combinations.thematic_resonance: A name is a vain thing; only by letting go of the reputation can one be at ease.

example_combinations.combination: K07 Lost in the Wheel of Rebirth + F06 Golden Fire Eyes + Z01 Pride
example_combinations.story_opening: Wukong strays into the six paths of rebirth and is reborn as a mere mortal, yet his Golden Fire Eyes remain and show him demons all around.
example_combinations.story_continuation: Too proud to admit that he is a mortal, Wukong insists on fighting the demons and is struck down by a mortal's fists.
example_combinations.key_conflict: Pride bars him from accepting his mortal identity and from judging his own strength.
example_combinations.thematic_resonance: Obsession is the greatest enemy; more frightening than demons is the pride in one's own heart.

example_combinations.combination: K10 A Heavenly Tribulation Descends + F04 Plantain Fan + Z07 Obsession with Longevity
example_combinations.story_opening: A heavenly tribulation descends; a demon, obsessed with longevity, tries to fan it away with the Plantain Fan.
example_combinations.story_continuation: But the tribulation is the way of heaven; the Plantain Fan cannot stand against heaven, and the demon is finally reduced to ashes.
example_combinations.key_conflict: The obsession with longevity makes the demon unscrupulous, yet it still cannot rival the way of heaven.
example_combinations.thematic_resonance: Longevity is a vain thing; only by following the way of heaven can one be at ease.

example_combinations.combination: K12 True and False Hard to Tell + F05 Diamond Snare + Z09 Jealousy
example_combinations.story_opening: A man identical to Wukong appears, holding the Diamond Snare and claiming to be the true Wukong.
example_combinations.story_continuation: The false Wukong, jealous of the true one, uses the Diamond Snare to take the true Wukong's Golden Cudgel and leave him in a fix.
example_combinations.key_conflict: Jealousy is the false Wukong's obsession, driving him to impersonate another.
example_combinations.thematic_resonance: Jealousy is the greatest enemy; more frightening than an indistinguishable double is the jealousy in one's own heart.

design_philosophy: Three card groups · 32 cards · generating 12 × 10 × 10 = 1200 story openings
